name: Harvard University
officialName: President and Fellows of Harvard College
summary: Harvard College is the undergraduate school of Harvard University in Cambridge, Massachusetts. Students apply to the College rather than a major and declare a concentration, such as Economics or Computer Science, in their third semester. First-years live in Harvard Yard and later move to one of 12 residential Houses; housing is guaranteed for four years.

undergraduates.notes: Harvard College students, as stated on the College's About page.

applicationPlatform.value: Common Application or Coalition Application by Scoir, plus Harvard's supplement

testing.notes: If neither is accessible, AP, IB, A-level or externally assessed national exam results can meet the requirement in exceptional cases.

internationalTuition.notes: Tuition only; Harvard's billed fees add US$6,216. Same for domestic and international students.

scholarships.name: Harvard College need-based financial aid
scholarships.eligibility: All admitted students, including international students; aid is based on family need. Families earning US$100,000 or less pay nothing; families earning US$200,000 or less pay no tuition.
scholarships.coverage: Up to the full cost of attendance, plus start-up and launch grants for families under US$100,000

housing.value: First-years live in Harvard Yard; sophomores to seniors live in one of 12 residential Houses of 400–500 students. Housing is guaranteed for four years.

admissionStats.notes: Yield 83.6%; 90% among international admits. Harvard did not publish admission figures for the Class of 2030.

admissionProcess.detail: Restrictive Early Action by 1 November or Regular Decision by 1 January.
Apply through the Common App or the Coalition Application by Scoir, with Harvard's supplement and school materials.
Send SAT or ACT scores (REA: preferably by end of October). English tests are optional and cannot replace the SAT/ACT.
Apply for aid alongside your application. Admission is need-blind for all applicants, including international students, who are eligible for the same aid.

feeBreakdown.item: Health insurance (unless covered by a family plan)

feeBreakdown.notes: Personal US$2,500, books US$1,000, travel US$0–5,000.
